descriptions: Lead a squad of 5 developers, owning technical direction, task planning, and code reviews to keep delivery predictable and quality consistent.
Built and maintained full-stack platforms for mining-industry clients covering personnel identification, dining hall registration, lodging, and transportation, used daily by 2,000+ workers.
Designed and built the company's shared React component library, adopted by 8+ frontend projects and cutting new UI development time by ~40%.
Co-developed a unified authentication platform with Keycloak, centralizing SSO and access control across 10+ company applications.
Migrated legacy .NET services to Python as part of the backend modernization, reducing average API response times by ~30%.
Introduced AI-assisted development workflows with Claude, OpenCode, MCP servers, and custom agent skills, paired with code review and automated tests.

Designed and delivered end-to-end serverless workflows with AWS Lambda and EventBridge to process 10,000+ policy records daily, with real-time status updates, comprehensive logging, and WebSocket notifications to the frontend.
Built PDF generation services on Lambda covering document creation, ZIP packaging, and secure pre-signed S3 URLs for user downloads.
Automated AWS deployments through Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, cutting release time from hours to under 15 minutes, and enforced code quality with Jest and Cucumber automated tests.
Built 6+ full-stack web applications with responsive interfaces and optimized API integrations, implementing authentication, route protection, and CRON jobs for task automation.
Designed and deployed network infrastructure with Terraform and DigitalOcean to migrate servers between domains, including VPC configuration for secure service connectivity.
Developed SDN-based web applications for analyzing and monitoring network devices, improving network management for routers and switches.
Analyzed KPIs for voice and data administration in a telecommunications network environment to keep network performance at optimal levels.
Automated report generation with Python and wrote configuration scripts for network elements, improving operational efficiency.

lab.name: NetPulse

lines.one: This is <accent>NetPulse</accent>, a real-time SDN monitoring platform I built end to end, released as v1.0.
lines.two: A Mininet network under an <accent>OS-Ken controller</accent> streams port stats into TimescaleDB every five seconds.
lines.three: The dashboard shows <accent>live KPIs, the topology and per-port throughput</accent> over WebSockets.
lines.four: <accent>EWMA baselines</accent> score every port; an alert opens only after three consecutive signals, is routed to webhooks by severity, and baselines survive restarts.
lines.five: Fault injection proves it: a downed host opens a <accent>critical drop-rate alert</accent> within 13 to 18 seconds and resolves on its own about a minute after the fault clears.

lab.topology: Topology: switch s1 links s2 and s3; s2 serves 10.0.0.1 and 10.0.0.2, s3 serves 10.0.0.3 and 10.0.0.4.
